# Faculty Time Tracker

Plan, log, and understand the time you spend on **research**, **teaching**, and **service**.

Faculty Time Tracker is a focused workspace for turning a busy academic week into a useful record. Sign in with Google, connect a Google Sheet that you control, and keep your activity data in one place.

## Your records stay connected to your workflow

The app uses Google Sheets for activities, settings, and semester calendar information. You can create a new sheet or connect an existing one, then open it whenever you want to inspect or manage your records directly.

**Includes**

- Google sign-in
- Semester-aware activity tracking
- Faculty workload targets
- PDF and Excel exports
- Dashboard summaries and trends

</section>
